wiki.content: "Wanna Be Startin' Somethin'" is an uptempo funk and post-disco track by Michael Jackson, released on May 8, 1983, as the fourth single from his landmark album Thriller. The song was written and composed by Jackson and produced by Jackson and Quincy Jones. Originally intended for his sister La Toya Jackson’s debut album, the song was ultimately recorded by Michael and became one of the most energetic and rhythmically complex tracks on Thriller. It features layered percussion, blazing horns, and dynamic vocal arrangements that emphasize paranoia, media pressure, and interpersonal conflict. Lyrically, the song addresses rumors, gossip, and emotional manipulation, with Jackson delivering lines like "You're a vegetable / You're just a buffet" that have been widely interpreted and debated. Its intense, danceable rhythm and staccato vocal delivery highlight Jackson’s ability to merge social commentary with infectious grooves. The track culminates in a memorable chant—"Mama-say mama-sa mama-coo-sa"—which was borrowed from Cameroonian saxophonist Manu Dibango’s 1972 song "Soul Makossa." This chant led to a legal dispute in 1986, which was later settled out of court. "Wanna Be Startin' Somethin'" was a critical and commercial success, reaching number five on the Billboard Hot 100 and becoming a Top 10 hit in several other countries. Though it was not initially accompanied by a music video, Jackson frequently performed it live, using it as a high-energy opener for his Bad, Dangerous, and HIStory world tours. Its infectious rhythm, sharp lyrics, and complex instrumentation have made it a staple of Jackson's live performances and one of the defining tracks of his career. The song's influence has endured well beyond its initial release. In 2008, it was reworked as "Wanna Be Startin' Somethin' 2008" featuring Akon for the compilation album Thriller 25, introducing it to a new generation. It remains one of the most celebrated examples of Jackson's ability to combine pop, funk, and political commentary into a seamless, danceable experience. "Wanna Be Startin' Somethin'" is widely regarded as one of the most explosive openers in pop album history and a testament to Michael Jackson's musical genius.
